turns.reply:
I made the maze Pac-Man bigger and his mouth now shows which way he's heading. It's in PR #97: https://github.com/fischerq/ludumdare60/pull/97

**What was wrong:** In an in-game screenshot, Pac-Man was 20 px across while the ghosts are 20x22, so he looked smaller. Two of his seven chomp frames (the first and last) were plain circles, which give no direction.

**What changed:**
- **Chomp:** I redrew all seven frames at 24 px across, in Max's style (black outline, blue-white edge around the mouth). The mouth never fully closes now: the first frame is a slit and the last is the widest. In a new screenshot he's about the size of the ghosts and clearly facing left.
- **Death:** I redrew the first five frames at the same 24 px so he doesn't shrink the moment he dies. Max's last five frames, where he shrinks away, are unchanged.
- **Max's frames:** These were his drawn files, so I edited them in place. That drops his two squashed crescent frames from the chomp. They're still in git if he wants them back or wants to redo the bigger version himself.
- **Elsewhere:** The menu and credits use the same frames, so he's bigger there too.
- **Not changed:** the spare-life icons under the maze are still Max's smaller version.

**To test on the phone:** turn through a few corners and check you can always tell which way he's facing, that he fits the corridors without crowding the walls, and that dying doesn't pop in size.
